message: You're having a hard time keeping up with the conversation, aren't you? Newsflash: individual freedom isn't about "defending your homestead" or some fantasy of rugged individualism. It's about being able to make choices about your own life, like whether or not to own a gun, without some self-righteous busybody like you trying to dictate what's best for you. And as for the NRA, at least they're not a bunch of ideological poseurs who think the solution to every problem is more government control. You know who's "brainwashed"? Someone who thinks that the Founding Fathers would be okay with stripping Americans of their Second Amendment rights. Give me a break, you're just a puppet for the gun-grabbing crowd, spouting off talking points from your favorite gun-control blog.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'self-righteous' and a 'puppet' for the 'gun-grabbing crowd', directly attacking their motivations and implying they are not acting in good faith.  Also uses 'brainwashed' to delegitimize their position.
